name: Tag Input
description: A text field where each entry turns into a removable tag, with validation, a limit and an optional suggestion list.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the field. Clicking it focuses the text input.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the field. Replaced by the error while the field is invalid.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Shows the field as invalid with this message, whatever the tags are. Without it, the message of the first tag that fails validate is shown.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the new list whenever a tag is added or removed.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint shown while there are no tags.

props.name: size
props.description: Minimum height 32, 36 or 44 pixels. The field grows as tags wrap.

props.name: delimiters
props.description: Pasted text is split on these. Typing a one-character delimiter turns the text so far into a tag, as Enter and Tab do.

props.name: validate
props.description: Return true for a good tag or a message for a bad one. Bad tags are kept and shown in camellia, and the first message becomes the field's error.

props.name: maxTags
props.description: Most tags allowed. The text input hides once it is reached, and the help row counts "n of max".

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Values offered in a list under the field, filtered as you type. Up and Down move through it, Enter or Tab picks, Escape closes. Tags already added are left out.

props.name: allowDuplicates
props.description: Allow the same tag twice. When false, a repeat (ignoring case) is not added and the existing tag flashes instead.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the field and dims it to 50%.

props.name: isReadOnly
props.description: Shows the tags on a muted fill with no input and no remove buttons.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Other props are spread onto the root element.
